mLocKeys.keySummary: Gangplank uncovers a powder keg at target location. If he attacks it, it explodes, spreading the attack's damage to enemies in the area, slowing them.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Gangplank places a powder keg that can be attacked by Gangplank and enemy champions for @Effect5Amount@ seconds. When an enemy destroys it, the keg is defused. When Gangplank destroys it, it explodes, Slowing by @FinalSlowAmount@% for @Effect2Amount@ seconds and dealing the Attack's damage, ignoring @Effect10Amount@% Armor. Champions take an additional @Effect3Amount@ physical damage.

Keg health decays every @BarrelDecayTime@ seconds. Keg explosions detonate other kegs with overlapping blast zones, but don't deal damage to the same target more than once. Keg explosions triggered by {{Spell_GangplankQWrapper_Name}} will grant the bonus gold for targets killed.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Keg decay rate increases at level 7 and 13.</rules>

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Powder Keg</titleLeft><mainText>Gangplank can explode these kegs to damage and slow enemies in the area.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Groggy</titleLeft><mainText>Gangplank's exploding powder keg slowed this unit's movement.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

Trial by FireEvery @f3@ seconds, Gangplank's next melee attack ignites the target, dealing @f1@ (+@f2@) bonus true damage over 2.5 seconds (half damage against turrets) and granting Gangplank 30% Move Speed for 2 seconds.

Destroying a Powder Keg refreshes Trial by Fire and grants him the Move Speed.

Parrrley does not activate Trial by Fire.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Every few seconds, Gangplank's melee strike will set his opponent on fire.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Gangplank's melee Attacks ignite the target, dealing an additional @TotalDamage@ true damage over @DoTDuration@ seconds and granting Gangplank @MoveSpeed@ Move Speed for @MoveSpeedDuration@ seconds.

Destroying a Powder Keg refreshes this Cooldown and grants Gangplank the same Move Speed.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
{{Spell_GangplankPassive_Tooltip}}

Deals @TurretDamageMult*100@% damage to turrets.
{{Spell_GangplankQWrapper_Name}} does not apply this Ability.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Gangplank signals his ship to bombard an area, slowing and damaging enemies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Gangplank signals his ship to fire @TotalWavesTooltip@ waves of cannonballs anywhere on the map over @ZoneDuration@ seconds. Each wave Slows by @SlowPercent@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds and deals @OneWaveDamage@ magic damage. Maximum damage: @TotalDamageTooltip@

This Ability can be upgraded in the shop via {{Spell_GangplankQWrapper_Name}}.

Fire at Will: Fires 6 additional waves of cannonballs.
Death's Daughter: Fires a Mega-Cannonball that deals @DeathsDaughterDamage@ true damage and Slows by @DeathsDaughterSlow@% for @DeathsDaughterSlowDuration@ second.
Raise Morale: Allies inside Cannon Barrage gain @RaiseMoraleHaste@% Move Speed for @RaiseMoraleHasteDuration@ seconds.

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Gangplank consumes a large amount of citrus fruit, removing all <status>Disabling</status> effects and restoring <healing>@BaseHealth@ plus @Effect2Amount@% missing Health</healing>.
